name: openbook-js
description: OpenBook JavaScript client: read an OpenBook feed over a socket or HTTP, cache the documents, and bind them to React.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @openbook/core && npm run build -w @openbook/pricing && npm run build -w @openbook/react
scripts.ci: npm run check:schema && npm run check:gen && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
